notes.text:
Album title on center labels:
"390 Degrees Of Simulated Stereo Pere Ubu Live Volume One"
Subtitle on front:
"Pere Ubu in Cleveland, London & Brussels.

B3-B5 recorded May '76 at The Mistake in Cleveland on a portable cassette machine. 
B6 recorded August 4 '77 at Pirate's Cove in The Flats, Cleveland on a reel-to-reel 
A6 recorded October 14 '77 at Ubu rehearsal loft in Cleveland on one channel of a reel-to-reel 
A3, A4 recorded February 18 '78 at Disasto 2, WHK Auditorium in Cleveland on a reel-to-reel 
A2 recorded May 5 '78 at Theater 140 in Brussels 
A1, B2 recorded December 5 '78 at College of Printing in London by a mobile recording unit 
B1 recorded December 6 '78 at Brunel University in Uxbridge by a mobile recording unit 
A5 recorded March 2 '79 at International Garage Exhibition, Cleveland State University on a portable cassette machine
